title: create-graph-app Template
description: Metadata contract every templates/<category>/<name>/template.yaml must satisfy. See docs/architecture.md for why this is smaller than graph-templates/TEMPLATE-SPEC.md.

id.description: Dotted category.name, matches the template's directory path, e.g. frontend.nextjs

name.description: Human-readable name shown in prompts, e.g. "Next.js"

requires.description: Capability strings this template needs some OTHER selected template to provide, e.g. "frontend". Never a template id — see architecture.md.

provides.description: Capability strings this template satisfies, e.g. ["frontend", "react", "routing"].

compatibleWith.description: Template ids this one is known to work well with. Advisory — used for prompt ordering/suggestions, not enforced.

conflictsWith.description: Template ids that must never be selected alongside this one. Enforced — the resolver hard-errors.

scripts.description: npm scripts this template contributes to its target app's package.json, e.g. { "dev": "tsx watch src/index.ts" }. Merged by config-generator.ts — package.json is generated from structured metadata (dependencies + scripts), never from a files[] operation, so there is exactly one code path that writes it.

default.description: A safe, non-secret example value written to .env.example, e.g. "http://localhost:3000".

documentation.description: Path to this template's own doc fragment, relative to the template's directory, e.g. "docs/nextjs.md".

targetApp.description: Which generated workspace this template's files belong under in a multi-app (apps/web, apps/api) layout. "root" means the project root (single-app projects, or root-level shared config).

when.description: Same three-form condition syntax as a file operation's `when` (see fileOperation.when) — omit for a dependency that's always installed. Lets a template avoid installing packages a particular config combination doesn't need, e.g. tailwindcss only when frontend.ui!=none.

src.description: Source path relative to the template's files/ directory. Required for copy/template/append; ignored for create/merge.

dest.description: Destination path relative to the target workspace root (see targetApp). Required for every op except conditional (whose nested `then` operations each have their own).

content.description: Inline content for op: create when no src file is used.

mergeStrategy.description: Required when op: merge — names the composer.ts strategy that merges this template's contribution into a file another template may have also written. package.json and .env.example are NOT mergeable file targets — they're generated entirely from structured metadata (dependencies/scripts/environment) by config-generator.ts, so there is exactly one code path that writes each.

when.description: A condition over a dotted ProjectConfig path — required when op: conditional. Three forms: "a.b" (truthy), "a.b=value" (equality), "a.b!=value" (inequality — the form to use for enum-shaped fields like frontend.ui, since "unset" is the literal string "none", not undefined, and is therefore truthy under a bare truthy check). See src/utils/render.ts.

then.description: Nested operations run only when `when` is truthy — required when op: conditional.
